由 re-（回）加 act 构成，义为「作出反应；起化学反应」

senses.title: To do something about a situation
senses.definition: to do something, especially in order to deal with a problem or a chance
senses.definitionCN: 做某事，尤其是为了处理问题或抓住机会
senses.example: We have to act now, before the water reaches the door.
senses.exampleCN: 我们得趁水还没漫到门口赶紧行动。
senses.why: Latin agere is to drive and set in motion; to act is to put force behind a move so that something actually happens.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 agere 意为「驱动、使运转」；act 就是给一个动作加上推力，让它真的发生。

senses.title: To behave in a certain way
senses.definition: to behave in the way described, especially towards other people
senses.definitionCN: 以所述的方式举止，尤其是对待他人时
senses.example: He acted as if nothing had happened.
senses.exampleCN: 他表现得好像什么都没发生过。
senses.why: A person carries a set of manners and is driven by them; how you act is how you present yourself before others.
senses.whyCN: 人身上带着一套待人接物的规矩，并被它驱动；你怎样 act，就是在别人面前怎样呈现自己。

senses.title: To perform a role
senses.definition: to perform a part in a play, film or show
senses.definitionCN: 在戏剧、电影或节目中扮演一个角色
senses.example: She has acted in three plays this year.
senses.exampleCN: 她今年演了三部话剧。
senses.why: The stage is where doing is watched: to act is to drive a character through a scene in front of an audience.
senses.whyCN: 舞台是「做」被观看的地方：act 就是当着观众，把一个人物从头到尾驱动一遍。

senses.title: To have an effect
senses.definition: of a drug, force or process, to have an effect on something
senses.definitionCN: 指药物、力量或过程对某物产生影响
senses.example: The medicine acts quickly on a headache.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药对头痛起效很快。
senses.why: A thing that acts is a thing that drives change into an object; an effect is action arriving somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 会 act 的东西，就是能把改变驱动到对象身上的东西；效果就是动作抵达了某处。

senses.title: A single thing done
senses.definition: a particular thing that someone does, often judged as good or bad
senses.definitionCN: 某人做的某一件事，常被判断为善或恶
senses.example: Saving the child was a brave act.
senses.exampleCN: 救下那个孩子是一个勇敢的举动。
senses.why: The verb becomes a countable noun: one completed act of driving is a deed you can point to.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成可数名词之后，一次完成的驱动就是一个可以指认出来的行为。

senses.title: A law passed by a parliament
senses.definition: a formal decision of a parliament or similar body that becomes law
senses.definitionCN: 议会或类似机构作出的、成为法律的正式决定
senses.example: Parliament passed an act banning single-use plastic.
senses.exampleCN: 议会通过了一项禁止一次性塑料的法案。
senses.why: A law is what a governing body has driven into force; the Latin noun actus also meant an official measure.
senses.whyCN: 法律是统治机构推动并使之生效的东西；拉丁名词 actus 本来就指官方举措。

senses.title: A division of a play
senses.definition: one of the main divisions of a play, opera or similar work
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧、歌剧或类似作品中主要的段落之一
senses.example: The curtain rises on the second act.
senses.exampleCN: 第二幕的幕布升了起来。
senses.why: Latin actus also named a section of a drama, a stretch of action that completes one movement.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actus 也指戏剧的一个段落，也就是走完一个动作单元的一段行动。

senses.title: A short performance in a show
senses.definition: a short performance by one person or group within a variety show or concert
senses.definitionCN: 综艺节目或演唱会上由一人或一组人完成的短表演
senses.example: The comedy act brought the audience to its feet.
senses.exampleCN: 那个喜剧节目让全场观众站了起来。
senses.why: From the stage sense grows the noun for the item itself: the act is the piece the audience has come to watch.
senses.whyCN: 从舞台义长出指节目本身的名词：act 就是观众买票来看的那一段。

intro.en: Act goes back to a Latin verb of driving, and its noun branch already covered deeds, laws and divisions of a play.
intro.cn: act 可追到拉丁语中表示「驱动」的动词，它的名词分支早已覆盖行为、法律和戏剧段落。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ag- meant 'to drive, lead, set in motion'; the deeper origin beyond this reconstruction is source uncertain.
items.cn: 重构词根 *ag- 意为「驱赶、带领、使运转」；这一重构形式之前的更早来源不确定。

items.en: Agere meant 'to drive, lead, do, perform'. It also produced agent, agenda and actor.
items.cn: agere 意为「驱动、带领、做、执行」，还生出 agent、agenda 与 actor。

items.en: The noun actus meant 'a driving, a doing, a deed', and in the theatre it named a section of a play.
items.cn: 名词 actus 意为「驱动、行为、事迹」，在戏剧里也指一出戏的段落。

items.en: Old French took the Latin noun as acte and passed it into English with both the deed sense and the stage sense.
items.cn: 古法语把拉丁名词吸收为 acte，并连同「行为」与「戏剧段落」两义一起传入英语。

items.en: Parliament gave the word its legal sense, and popular theatre gave it the sense of a short turn on a bill.
items.cn: 议会赋予它法律义，通俗剧场则赋予它「节目单上的一个短节目」这一义。

note.en: The look-alike group collects the Latin agere family; the near-meaning group separates doing, behaving, performing and law-making.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语 agere 这一族；近义组区分「做」「举止」「表演」与「立法」。

entries.definition: The noun for the process of doing something, or a thing done; the -ion form of act.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、动作」，是 act 加 -ion 的形式，与本词同根。

entries.definition: A person who performs roles, literally 'a doer'; the -or form of act.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员、行动者」，字面就是「做事的人」，是 act 加 -or 的形式。

entries.definition: Real rather than imagined, from the same Latin noun for a done thing.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「实际的、真实的」，来自同一个表示「已做成之事」的拉丁名词。

entries.definition: To make a proposal into law, or to perform something in real life.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「制定法律、颁布」或「把……付诸实施」，由 en- 加 act 构成。

entries.definition: The list of things to be done at a meeting, literally 'things to be driven'.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「议事日程」，字面是「要被推动去做的事」，同出 agere。

entries.definition: To conduct oneself in a particular way; it covers only the manner sense of act.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「举止、表现」，只对应 act 的举止义，不表示行动或表演。

entries.definition: A notable act, usually a brave or noble one; narrower and more formal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「事迹、行为」，多指勇敢或高尚之举，范围更窄、语气更正式。

entries.definition: To carry out a task or present a show; it stresses execution rather than a single deed.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「执行、演出」，强调完成的过程，而不是单个举动。

entries.definition: The whole body of rules, or a single rule; an act is one statute within it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「法律」，指整套规则或一条规则；act 只是其中的一部成文法。

entries.definition: A proposed law still being debated; it becomes an act only after it is passed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「议案」，尚在辩论中的法律草案，通过之后才成为 act。

normalIntro.en: The hooks work from the real Latin verb agere, its English family and the phrases act actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子来自真实的拉丁动词 agere、它在英语中的词族，以及 act 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: agere means to drive: to act is to get something moving.
normal.cn: agere 意为「驱动」：act 就是让某事动起来。

normal.en: The family is easy to hear: act, action, actor, active, agenda all share the stem.
normal.cn: 这一族一听就懂：act、action、actor、active、agenda 共用一个词干。

normal.en: Act as a guide means to serve in that role while the event lasts.
normal.cn: act as a guide 意为在活动期间担任向导这个角色。

normal.en: A machine that acts up stops working properly, as if it were misbehaving.
normal.cn: 机器 act up 就是不好好工作，像在闹脾气。

normal.en: Act one, scene one is how a play marks its first division.
normal.cn: Act one, scene one 就是一出戏标注第一幕第一场的方式。

abstract.en: One spotlight, one body, one movement: the whole word is a deed being watched.
abstract.cn: 一束追光、一个身体、一个动作：整个词就是一件被观看的行为。

abstract.en: Action, actor and act all point back to the same push that starts a movement.
abstract.cn: action、actor、act 都指向同一股让动作开始的推力。

abstract.en: A law, a play and a good deed are all things that have been 'done' and then written down.
abstract.cn: 一部法律、一出戏、一件善事，都是先被「做」出来，然后被写下来的东西。

examples.en: She acted as if nothing had happened, which made everyone uneasy.
examples.cn: 她表现得好像什么都没发生，这让大家都不自在。

examples.en: The new rules will act as a brake on waste.
examples.cn: 新规定将起到遏制浪费的作用。

examples.en: His first act as mayor was to reopen the library.
examples.cn: 他当市长后的第一个举动是重新开放图书馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱磕它」——演员一遍遍磕台词，把动作演出来：表演、行动、行为。

root: 拉丁语 agere「驱动、带领、做、执行」（原始印欧语重构词根 *ag-「驱赶」）→ 名词 actus「驱动、行为、戏剧段落」；经古法语 acte 进入英语。同族有 action、actor、agent、agenda。

sensesIntro.en: Act is one push made visible: it appears as a move you take, a way you behave, a role you play, an effect a thing has, a deed, a statute, a division of a play or a turn on stage.
sensesIntro.cn: act 就是一次被看见的推力：它可以是你采取的行动、你的举止、你扮演的角色、某物的作用、一件行为、一部法令、戏剧的一幕，或舞台上的一个节目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body in the middle of a lit stage makes one movement that everyone can see.
core.cn: 核心意象：聚光灯下的舞台中央，一个身体做出一个所有人都看得见的动作。

branches.en: THE PUSH: acting is starting a movement, whether a person or a medicine does it.
branches.cn: 推力线：act 是让运动开始，无论施动者是人还是药物。

branches.en: THE MANNER: the same push becomes the style of behaviour others read.
branches.cn: 举止线：同一股推力变成别人读到的行为方式。

branches.en: THE STAGE: the doing is put on show, and the item performed is also an act.
branches.cn: 舞台线：动作被展示出来，被演出的那一段也叫 act。

branches.en: THE DEED: one completed push becomes a countable thing to judge.
branches.cn: 行为线：一次完成的推力变成可以评判的可数之事。

branches.en: THE WRITTEN FORM: a statute and a division of a play are both actions fixed on paper.
branches.cn: 成文线：一部法令与戏剧的一幕，都是被固定在纸上的行动。

intro.en: Act is a bare Latin root in English; its family grows with ordinary suffixes and prefixes.
intro.cn: act 是直接进入英语的拉丁词根，它的词族靠普通后缀和前缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: Agere, actus, actio and actor are all recorded Latin words, so only the Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere、actus、actio、actor 都是有记录的拉丁词，只有印欧词根属于重构形式。

senses.title: The process of doing something
senses.definition: the process of doing something, especially in order to reach a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 做某事的过程，尤指为了达到某个目的
senses.example: The report is full of fine words but calls for action.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告辞藻漂亮，却呼唤真正的行动。
senses.why: Actio in Latin is the doing itself; the noun names the ongoing drive rather than any single finished result.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actio 就是「做」这件事本身；这个名词命名的是正在进行的驱动，而不是某一个完成的结果。

senses.title: A step taken to solve a problem
senses.definition: a specific thing that is done in order to deal with a problem or reach a goal
senses.definitionCN: 为处理问题或达成目标而做的具体一件事
senses.example: The council took immediate action to clear the blocked drains.
senses.exampleCN: 市政会立即采取措施清理堵塞的下水道。
senses.why: If the doing is a drive, a measure is one push of that drive aimed at a particular obstacle.
senses.whyCN: 如果把「做」看成一股驱动，那么一项措施就是这股驱动对准某个具体障碍的一次推动。

senses.title: The way something works
senses.definition: the way a substance, force or mechanism produces its effect
senses.definitionCN: 物质、力量或机构产生效果的方式
senses.example: The action of the poison is slow but irreversible.
senses.exampleCN: 这种毒物的作用缓慢却不可逆。
senses.why: A thing acts on another; the noun for that acting is the working of one thing upon another.
senses.whyCN: 一物对另一物 act；指这种施动的名词，就是一物作用于另一物的运作方式。

senses.title: A case in court
senses.definition: a legal case brought to a court to decide a right or a wrong
senses.definitionCN: 提交法院、用以判定是非的诉讼案件
senses.example: She is threatening legal action against the builder.
senses.exampleCN: 她正威胁要对建筑商提起诉讼。
senses.why: Latin actio already meant a legal proceeding: the doing is done in court, and the court gives it a name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actio 本来就指法律程序：这种「做」在法庭上进行，法庭给了它一个专门名称。

senses.title: Fighting in a battle
senses.definition: fighting between armed forces, especially in a particular place or period
senses.definitionCN: 武装力量之间的交火，尤指在某一地点或时期
senses.example: He was wounded in action near the border.
senses.exampleCN: 他在边境附近的一次战斗中负伤。
senses.why: War is the most concentrated form of doing; what soldiers do is simply called action.
senses.whyCN: 战争是「做」最集中的形态；士兵所做的事就被直接称为行动。

senses.title: The call that starts a film take
senses.definition: the word a director calls to signal that filming or recording should begin
senses.definitionCN: 导演示意开始拍摄或录音时喊出的那个词
senses.example: The director called action and the extras began to walk.
senses.exampleCN: 导演喊了开拍，群众演员开始走动。
senses.why: On a film set the doing is waiting, held still, until one word releases it; that word is the action.
senses.whyCN: 在片场，动作被按住不动地等着，直到一个词把它放出来；那个词就是 action。

senses.title: The exciting events of a story
senses.titleCN: 情节中的动作；热闹场面
senses.definition: the sequence of exciting events in a story or film, or the place where they happen
senses.definitionCN: 故事或电影中一连串紧张事件，或这些事件发生的地点
senses.example: Most of the action takes place on a single night.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分情节都发生在一个晚上。
senses.why: A story is a chain of doings; the parts where things are actually done are simply the action.
senses.whyCN: 故事是一条「做」的链条；真正有事发生的那部分，就直接叫 action。

senses.title: The working part of a mechanism
senses.definition: the moving mechanism of a device such as a rifle or a piano, or the way it moves
senses.definitionCN: 步枪、钢琴等装置中运动的部分，或它运动的方式
senses.example: The rifle jammed after the third shot because sand got into the action.
senses.exampleCN: 第三枪之后步枪卡住了，因为沙进了机件里。
senses.why: The concrete end of the same idea: the part where the doing physically happens.
senses.whyCN: 同一个想法最具体的一端：履行动作的那个部件本身。

intro.en: Action is the Latin noun of doing, taken into French and then English, and it carries the legal sense from the beginning.
intro.cn: action 是拉丁语中表示「做」的名词，经法语进入英语，并且从一开始就带着法律义。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ag- meant 'to drive, set in motion'; the deeper source beyond this reconstruction is uncertain.
items.cn: 重构词根 *ag- 意为「驱赶、使运转」；这一重构形式之前的更早来源不确定。

items.en: Agere meant 'to drive, do, perform', and its family includes actor, agenda and actus.
items.cn: agere 意为「驱动、做、执行」，同族词包括 actor、agenda 与 actus。

items.en: Actio meant 'a doing, a performance' and also 'a legal proceeding'; both branches passed into later languages.
items.cn: actio 意为「做、执行」，也指「法律程序」；这两条分支都传入了后世语言。

items.en: Old French accion carried the word to English in the thirteenth century, with the legal sense already attached.
items.cn: 古法语 accion 在十三世纪把这个词带入英语，法律义当时已经附着其上。

items.en: Later centuries added military action, the action of a story, and finally the director's call on a film set.
items.cn: 此后几个世纪又添上军事行动、故事中的动作，最后是片场导演的那声喊话。

note.en: The look-alike group collects the agere family; the near-meaning group sets action beside a deed, a measure, an operation and a lawsuit.
note.cn: 形近组收 agere 这一族；近义组把 action 与行为、措施、运作、诉讼并列比较。

entries.definition: The shorter verb and noun for doing, performing or a statute; action is its -ion noun.
entries.definitionCN: 动词兼名词，义为「行动、表演、法案」；action 是它加 -ion 的名词形式，同根。

entries.definition: A performer or a doer, formed from the same Latin stem.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员、行动者」，由同一个拉丁词干构成。

entries.definition: The ability to act, or an organization that acts for others; from the same agere.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「能动性；代理机构」，本义是「起作用的能力」，同出 agere。

entries.definition: A list of things to be done; literally the things that must be driven forward.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「议程」，字面是「必须被推动去做的事」，同出 agere。

entries.definition: To pass a law or to carry something out in practice.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「颁布法律」或「付诸实施」，由 en- 加 act 构成。

entries.definition: A single act, usually judged by its moral quality; more formal and often noble.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行为、事迹」，通常按道德品质评判，语气更正式，多指高尚之举。

entries.definition: An official step taken to deal with a problem; close to the 'step' sense of action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「措施、办法」，接近 action 的「举措」义，但更强调官方性质。

entries.definition: The working of a machine, system or military plan; it stresses process rather than a single move.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「运作、军事行动」，强调过程或整套计划，而非单个动作。

entries.definition: A case brought to a civil court; a narrower word than legal action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「民事诉讼」，比 legal action 更窄，专指民事案件。

entries.definition: Fighting between armed forces; more explicit than the military sense of action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「战斗、作战」，比 action 的军事义更直白。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the real agere root, the action family and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的 agere 词根、action 的词族，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: agere is to drive: action is the driving force turned into a noun.
normal.cn: agere 是「驱动」：action 就是被名词化的那股驱动力。

normal.en: Add -ion to act and you get the process; keep the -or and you get the person.
normal.cn: act 加 -ion 得到过程，换成 -or 就得到做事的人。

normal.en: Take action is the most common phrase: do not just talk.
normal.cn: take action 是最常见的搭配：别光说，动手做。

normal.en: A course of action is the route a plan will follow.
normal.cn: course of action 是一个计划将要走的路线。

normal.en: In action means a thing is working, not sitting in a warehouse.
normal.cn: in action 指某物正在运转，而不是停在仓库里。

abstract.en: Picture a gear tooth catching: before it, everything is still; after it, the whole machine moves.
abstract.cn: 想象一个齿轮咬合的瞬间：之前一切静止，之后整台机器都动起来。

abstract.en: The same word covers a rescue, a lawsuit and a film set, because each is a switch being thrown.
abstract.cn: 同一个词覆盖救援、诉讼和片场，因为三者都是「闸被打开」的瞬间。

abstract.en: Action is the answer to the question 'what was actually done', not 'what was meant'.
abstract.cn: action 回答的是「实际做了什么」，而不是「本打算做什么」。

examples.en: The government promised action on housing within a year.
examples.cn: 政府承诺一年内在住房问题上采取行动。

examples.en: The brakes were tested in action on a wet road.
examples.cn: 刹车在湿滑路面上进行了实际运转测试。

examples.en: Her lawyer is preparing a legal action over the contract.
examples.cn: 她的律师正就该合同准备提起诉讼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱克身」——爱磕一身劲，抬起手就干：行动、动作、作用。

root: 拉丁语 agere「驱动、做」的名词形式 actio「做、执行、法律程序」，经古法语 accion 进入英语；同族有 act、actor、agent、agenda。原始印欧语重构词根 *ag-「驱赶」被认为成立，更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Action is doing seen from the outside: the process, one step, the working of a thing, a court case, fighting, a director's call, the events of a story, or the moving part of a machine.
sensesIntro.cn: action 是从外部看到的「做」：做事的过程、一个举措、某物的运作、一场官司、一场战斗、导演的一声喊、故事里的事件，或机器的运动部件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand throws a switch, gears engage, and a still machine starts to move.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手合上开关，齿轮咬合，静止的机器开始运转。

branches.en: THE DOING: action as an ongoing process, and as one step taken towards a goal.
branches.cn: 做事线：action 既是持续的过程，也是朝目标迈出的一步。

branches.en: THE WORKING: the way a substance acts, and the part of a machine where motion happens.
branches.cn: 运作线：物质起作用的方式，以及机器中真正发生运动的部件。

branches.en: THE COURT: a wrong is answered by legal action in front of a judge.
branches.cn: 法庭线：对于不法行为，在法官面前以诉讼回应。

branches.en: THE BATTLE: armed forces turn doing into fighting, called action in reports.
branches.cn: 战场线：武装力量把「做」变成战斗，战报里就称之为 action。

branches.en: THE STORY: the call that starts a take and the exciting events a story follows.
branches.cn: 故事线：让拍摄开始的那声口令，以及故事所追随的紧张事件。

intro.en: Action is a Latin noun built from a verb root plus a noun ending; English adds further prefixes and suffixes.
intro.cn: action 是拉丁语中由动词词根加名词词尾构成的名词；英语又添了更多前缀和后缀。

latinIntro.en: Agere, actio, actus and actor are recorded Latin forms, so only the Indo-European root is a reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: agere、actio、actus、actor 都是有记录的拉丁词形，只有印欧词根属于重构。

agere 提供这个词干。

items.exampleCN: actio 是 action 的直接来源。
它把 act 变成 action。

它构成 reaction。

它构成 actionable。

items.meaning: a person or thing connected with
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 actioner 里。

derivatives.zh: 由 action 加 -able 构成，义为「可付诸行动的；可起诉的」
由 re- 加 action 构成，义为「反应；反作用」
由 in- 加 action 构成，义为「不作为」

definition_zh: 活跃的；主动的；积极的；在职的；现役的；有效的；活性的；主动语态的
definition_en: doing things or ready to do them, taking the initiative, currently in service or working, having an effect, or naming the grammatical voice of the doer
core_image: 炉上一锅水滚开，气泡不停往上冲，热气顶着锅盖响
scene: 教室后几排平时不吭声的学生，今天也把手举了起来。She played an active part in the class discussion.
sceneCN: 这里的 active 是「主动的、积极参与的」（第 2 个义项：愿意参与并付诸行动）；句意为她在课堂讨论中起了积极主动的作用。

pos.zh: 活跃的；主动的；在职的；现役的；有效的；活性的；主动语态的

derivatives.zh: 由 active 加 -ity 构成，义为「活动；活跃；活性」
由 active 加 -ly 构成，义为「积极地；主动地」

senses.title: Full of movement and energy
senses.definition: moving about a lot and full of energy, used of people, places or markets
senses.definitionCN: 动得多、精力充沛，用于形容人、场所或市场
senses.example: The children stay active all morning at the pool.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在泳池里活跃了一整个上午。
senses.why: Activus in medieval Latin meant able to act; a person or place that keeps acting is the most direct picture of it.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 activus 意为「能起作用的」；一个不断在动的人或场所，就是这个意思最直接的画面。

senses.title: Willing to take the initiative
senses.definition: taking part willingly and doing things rather than watching others do them
senses.definitionCN: 愿意参与、动手去做，而不是看着别人做
senses.example: She takes an active interest in local politics.
senses.exampleCN: 她对本地政治抱有积极参与的兴趣。
senses.why: Able to act slides into willing to act: the capacity becomes a habit of stepping forward.
senses.whyCN: 「能够做」滑向「愿意做」：这种能力变成了一种主动上前的习惯。

senses.title: Serving or working at present
senses.definition: officially working or serving, as a member of an organization or of the armed forces
senses.definitionCN: 正式在职或在役，如某个组织的成员或武装部队的军人
senses.example: My uncle is still on active duty in the navy.
senses.exampleCN: 我叔叔还在海军服现役。
senses.why: An active member is one who is actually acting in the role, not a retired or honorary name on a list.
senses.whyCN: active 的成员是真正还在履行职责的人，而不是名单上退休的或名誉的名字。

senses.title: Producing the intended effect
senses.definition: of a substance or factor, producing the intended effect, especially the ingredient that does the work
senses.definitionCN: 指物质或因素产生预期效果，尤其指真正起作用的那个成分
senses.example: The active ingredient in the cream is a mild acid.
senses.exampleCN: 这款乳霜的有效成分是一种温和的酸。
senses.why: The ingredient that acts while others only carry it is active in the plainest sense: it is the one doing the work.
senses.whyCN: 在别的成分只负责承载时，那个真正起作用的成分就是最朴素意义上的 active：干活的是它。

senses.title: The grammatical voice of the doer
senses.definition: of a verb form, showing the subject as the one who performs the action
senses.definitionCN: 指动词形式，表明主语是执行动作的一方
senses.example: The sentence is clearer in the active voice.
senses.exampleCN: 这个句子用主动语态更清楚。
senses.why: Grammar borrowed the ordinary word: the active voice puts the doer in the driver's seat.
senses.whyCN: 语法借用了这个普通词：主动语态把做事的人放在驾驶座上。

senses.title: Connected and currently in operation
senses.titleCN: 运行中的；有效的（账户、设备）
senses.definition: of an account, device or connection, connected and currently working
senses.definitionCN: 指账户、设备或连接已接通、当前正在工作
senses.example: Your card stays active until the end of the month.
senses.exampleCN: 你的卡一直有效到月底。
senses.why: A thing that can still act is a thing still switched on; an inactive account has been cut off from acting.
senses.whyCN: 还能起作用的东西，就是还开着的东西；inactive 的账户则是被切断了作用能力。

senses.title: Of a volcano, still able to erupt
senses.definition: of a volcano, still liable to erupt, as opposed to dormant or extinct
senses.definitionCN: 指火山仍可能喷发，与休眠火山和死火山相对
senses.example: The island has one active volcano and several quiet ones.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛有一座活火山和几座安静的火山。
senses.why: A mountain that may still act keeps the oldest physical sense: the capacity to do something has not gone out.
senses.whyCN: 一座仍可能发作的山，保留了最古老的具体含义：做事的能力还没有熄灭。

senses.title: Able to affect a living system
senses.definition: of a substance, able to produce an effect in a living body or in a biological test
senses.definitionCN: 指物质能在活体或生物检测中产生效应
senses.example: The plant contains several biologically active compounds.
senses.exampleCN: 这种植物含有几种具有生物活性的化合物。
senses.why: Here the capacity to act is aimed at living tissue: the molecule can start a change inside a cell, so the same adjective calls it active.
senses.whyCN: 这里「能起作用」的对象是活组织：这个分子能在细胞内部引发改变，于是同一个形容词就称它为「有活性的」。

intro.en: Active is the medieval Latin adjective of doing, taken into English through French, and it keeps the whole range from busy to grammatical voice.
intro.cn: active 是中世纪拉丁语中表示「做」的形容词，经法语进入英语，并保留了从「忙碌」到「语法语态」的整片用法。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ag- meant 'to drive, set in motion'; the deeper origin of this root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 重构词根 *ag- 意为「驱赶、使运转」；这个更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Agere meant 'to drive, do, perform', and its noun actus gave the stem act- that the adjective would build on.
items.cn: agere 意为「驱动、做、执行」，它的名词 actus 提供了形容词所依附的词干 act-。

items.en: Actus meant 'a doing, a deed, a division of a play'; the participle actus also meant 'driven, done'.
items.cn: actus 意为「行为、事迹、戏剧的一幕」；作为分词它也表示「被驱动的、已做的」。

items.en: Actus plus the suffix -ivus produced activus 'able to act, busy'; the form is medieval rather than classical Latin.
items.cn: actus 加后缀 -ivus 构成 activus「能起作用的、忙碌的」；这一形式属于中世纪拉丁语，而非古典拉丁语。

items.en: English took the adjective from Latin and French; later centuries added the technical senses of duty, ingredients, volcanoes and electronics.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语和法语借入这个形容词；此后几个世纪又添上现役、有效成分、火山与电子元件等专业义。

note.en: The look-alike group collects the act- family; the near-meaning group sets active beside busy, lively, dynamic and its opposite passive.
note.cn: 形近组收 act- 一族；近义组把 active 与忙碌、活泼、有活力以及反义的被动并列。

entries.definition: The noun for doing; the -ion counterpart of the same stem.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动」，是同一词干的 -ion 对应形式，与本词同根。

entries.definition: The noun for being active or for a particular thing people do.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「活动、活跃」，由 active 加 -ity 构成。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to make something active or start it working.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「激活、使开始运转」，由 active 加 -ate 构成。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning in an active way; formed with -ly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「积极地、主动地」，由 active 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: A person who performs or acts, from the same Latin stem with the agent suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员、行动者」，同一拉丁词干加施动后缀构成。

entries.definition: Having a lot to do; it describes workload, while active describes energy and movement.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「忙的」，描述工作量的多少；active 描述精力与行动。

entries.definition: Full of life and quick movement, often of places, music or talk; warmer than active.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活泼的、热闹的」，多用于场所、音乐或谈话，比 active 更有温度。

entries.definition: Full of physical energy; it stresses stamina rather than participation.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「精力充沛的」，强调体力与耐力，而不是参与程度。

entries.definition: Constantly changing and producing movement; often used of systems and personalities.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有活力的、不断变化的」，多用于系统与个性。

entries.definition: Receiving action rather than doing it; the direct opposite in grammar and in temperament.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「被动的、消极的」，在语法和性情上都与 active 直接相对。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the real act- root, the -ive ending, the shared family and the phrases active appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的 act- 词根、-ive 词尾、共同的词族，以及 active 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: act- means do, and -ive means having the quality: active is having the quality of doing.
normal.cn: act- 意为「做」，-ive 意为「具有某种性质」：active 就是「具有做的性质」。

normal.en: The family runs act, action, active, activity, activate, activator in a straight line.
normal.cn: 这一族顺着一条线排开：act、action、active、activity、activate、activator。

normal.en: Active duty means a soldier is serving now, not in the reserves.
normal.cn: active duty 指军人正在服役，而不是在预备役。

normal.en: The active ingredient is the one that actually does the work in a medicine.
normal.cn: active ingredient 就是药物里真正起作用的那个成分。

normal.en: Active voice puts the doer first: she wrote the letter, not the letter was written.
normal.cn: 主动语态把做事的人放在前面：她写了信，而不是信被写了。

abstract.en: Picture a pot of water just before it boils: the moment the bubbles start, it is active.
abstract.cn: 想象一锅即将沸腾的水：气泡开始冒的那一刻，它就是 active。

abstract.en: The same word describes a child, a soldier, a drug, a volcano and a transistor: all of them are still able to act.
abstract.cn: 同一个词可以形容孩子、士兵、药物、火山和晶体管：它们都还「能起作用」。

abstract.en: Passive waits to be done to; active is already doing.
abstract.cn: 被动等着被别人作用；主动则已经在做。

examples.en: He has been an active member of the club since school.
examples.cn: 他从学生时代起就是这个俱乐部的活跃成员。

examples.en: The volcano has been active twice in the past century.
examples.cn: 这座火山在过去一百年里喷发过两次。

examples.en: Try to use the active voice when you write a report.
examples.cn: 写报告时尽量使用主动语态。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱克提夫」——爱磕、爱提，事事抢着上手：活跃的、主动的。

root: 拉丁语 agere「驱动、做」→ 名词 actus「行为」→ 中世纪拉丁语 activus「能起作用的、忙碌的」（actus 加 -ivus）；经法语进入英语。同族有 act、action、actor、activity、activate、activator。

sensesIntro.en: Active always says that something is able to act right now: a lively person, a willing participant, a serving soldier, a working ingredient, the doer's voice, a live account, a volcano, or a compound that changes living tissue.
sensesIntro.cn: active 始终表示某物此刻仍有作用能力：活泼的人、主动的参与者、正在服役的军人、真正起效的成分、施动者的语态、仍开通的账户、仍可能喷发的火山，或能改变活组织的化合物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pot on a stove is boiling hard, bubbles pushing the lid and steam hissing out.
core.cn: 核心意象：炉上的锅剧烈沸腾，气泡顶着锅盖，蒸汽嘶嘶冒出。

branches.en: THE ENERGY: a person, place or market that keeps moving.
branches.cn: 精力线：不断在动的人、场所或市场。

branches.en: THE WILL: the capacity to act becomes the choice to step forward.
branches.cn: 意愿线：「能做」变成「愿意上前做」。

branches.en: THE STATUS: serving in a role, or connected and working now.
branches.cn: 状态线：正在履行职务，或已接通、正在工作。

branches.en: THE EFFECT: the ingredient that does the work in a product, and the compound that changes living tissue.
branches.cn: 效用线：产品里真正起作用的成分，以及能改变活组织的化合物。

branches.en: THE FORCE: the doer placed first in grammar, and the mountain still able to erupt.
branches.cn: 力量线：语法里被放到首位的施动者，以及仍可能喷发的山。

definition_zh: 活动人士；积极分子；维权者；激进推动变革的人
definition_en: a person who works actively to bring about political or social change, often outside formal positions of power
core_image: 街口举着纸牌的人：要把自己的想法推到众人眼前
scene: 清晨的市政厅台阶上，几个人举着写满字的纸牌，安静地站成一排。A group of activists waited outside city hall with hand-painted signs.
sceneCN: 这里 activist 指「为公共议题公开行动的人」（第 1 个义项：社会议题的活动人士）；句意为一群活动人士举着手写标语在市政厅外等候。

pos.zh: 名词：活动人士；积极分子；维权者
形容词（作定语）：激进推动变革的

collocations.zh: 积极介入公司经营的投资人

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ism 构成，义为「行动主义；社会运动」
由本词加形容词后缀 -istic 构成，义为「行动主义的；积极介入的」
由前缀 anti- 加本词构成，义为「反对活动人士的」

senses.title: A campaigner for social change
senses.definition: a person who works publicly to bring about political or social change
senses.definitionCN: 公开为政治或社会变革而努力的人
senses.example: She became a human rights activist while still at university.
senses.exampleCN: 她还在读大学时就成了一名人权活动人士。
senses.why: The Latin root agere means to drive or do, and -ist marks the person who does, so an activist is literally one who keeps driving a cause forward.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 agere 意为「驱动、做」，-ist 标记做这件事的人；activist 字面上就是不断把一项事业往前推的人。

senses.title: An active member of a party or union
senses.titleCN: 政党或工会里的积极分子
senses.definition: a member of a party, union or similar body who works hard for it at local level
senses.definitionCN: 在政党、工会等团体基层努力做事的成员
senses.example: Every branch needs a few activists to knock on doors before the election.
senses.exampleCN: 选举前每个支部都需要几个积极分子去挨家敲门。
senses.why: The doer suffix narrows to organizational life: the activist is the member who does the unglamorous work inside a group.
senses.whyCN: 这个表示「做事者」的后缀收窄到组织生活里：activist 是团体内部做那些不出彩实事的人。

senses.title: An advocate for a single cause
senses.definition: a person who campaigns on one particular issue, such as the environment or animal welfare
senses.definitionCN: 围绕某一个特定议题开展倡导的人，如环保或动物福利
senses.example: Local activists have opposed the new road for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 当地的活动人士反对这条新路已经三年了。
senses.why: Once a cause becomes the thing being driven, the driver is named after it, so we say environmental activist or animal activist.
senses.whyCN: 当某个议题成为被推动的对象，推动者就以它命名，于是有了环保活动人士、动物保护活动人士这样的说法。

senses.title: Someone who takes direct action
senses.definition: a person who joins protests, blockades or occupations instead of working only through institutions
senses.definitionCN: 参加抗议、封锁或占领行动的人，而不只是走机构渠道
senses.example: The activists chained themselves to the gate at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 那些行动者在黎明时把自己锁在了大门上。
senses.why: If agere is to drive forward, the most physical form of driving is a body placed in the way.
senses.whyCN: 如果说 agere 是「向前驱动」，最物理的驱动形式就是把身体挡在路上。

senses.title: A campaigner organizing online
senses.definition: a person who builds support and pressure through social media and online networks
senses.definitionCN: 借助社交媒体和网络组织支持、施加压力的人
senses.example: A student activist turned a hashtag into a nationwide campaign.
senses.exampleCN: 一名学生活动分子把一个标签话题变成了全国性的运动。
senses.why: The driving now happens through shares and posts, but the medium changes while the doer stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 驱动如今通过转发和发帖完成；媒介变了，做事的人却没有变。

senses.title: An investor pressing for corporate change
senses.titleCN: 积极介入经营的投资人
senses.definition: in finance, an investor who buys a large stake and pushes a company to change its strategy or management
senses.definitionCN: 金融语境中买下大量股份、推动公司改变战略或管理层的投资人
senses.example: The board gave in after an activist investor bought a large stake.
senses.exampleCN: 一名积极介入的投资人买下大量股份后，董事会作出了让步。
senses.why: The word moves into markets: the thing being driven is no longer a cause but a company.
senses.whyCN: 这个词进入了市场：被推动的对象不再是某项事业，而是一家公司。

senses.title: Used before a noun: pushing for change
senses.titleCN: 作定语：主张激进变革的
senses.definition: used before a noun to describe a group, policy or court that actively pushes for change instead of preserving things as they are
senses.definitionCN: 用于名词前，形容某个团体、政策或法院积极推动变革，而非维持现状
senses.example: The group took its case to an activist court.
senses.exampleCN: 该团体把案子送到了以推动变革著称的法院。
senses.why: As a modifier the word sheds the person and keeps the force, so the pushing itself becomes the quality described.
senses.whyCN: 作定语时这个词卸下了「人」的身份却保留了力度：推动本身成了被描述的性质。

senses.title: A critical label for judges
senses.titleCN: 贬义标签：所谓「司法能动」的
senses.definition: in political debate, a critical label for judges said to make policy instead of applying the law
senses.definitionCN: 政治争论中带有批评意味的标签，指被指控制定政策而非适用法律的法官
senses.example: Critics called the ruling the work of activist judges.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者称这项裁决出自所谓「司法能动」的法官之手。
senses.why: The same force praised in a campaigner is blamed in a judge: driving change where the critic thinks none should be driven.
senses.whyCN: 活动人士身上被赞许的那股推动力，落到法官身上就成了指责：在批评者看来，本不该推动的地方却被推动了。

intro.en: Activist is an English formation on the Latin verb agere, with a Greek-derived person suffix; the family is old, the word itself recent.
intro.cn: activist 是在拉丁语动词 agere 基础上构成的英语词，配上一个源自希腊语的人物后缀；词族古老，这个词本身却很晚。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as 'to drive, set in motion'. The deeper origin of this root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 表示「驱动、使运动」；这个更早的来源不确定。

items.en: The verb agere meant 'to drive, lead, do, act', and its past participle was actus.
items.cn: 动词 agere 意为「驱动、引领、做、行动」，其过去分词是 actus。

items.en: The noun actus meant 'a driving, a doing, an act'; English drew act and action from this branch.
items.cn: 名词 actus 意为「驱动、作为、行为」；英语的 act 与 action 都取自这一支。

items.en: Act entered English from Latin and Old French, first naming a deed, then the doing of it.
items.cn: act 经拉丁语与古法语进入英语，最初指一件做过的事，后来也指做的过程。

items.en: Activist joins act to the suffix -ist, which came from Greek -istes through Latin -ista. The word is recorded from the early twentieth century and spread with mass political movements.
items.cn: activist 由 act 加后缀 -ist 构成，这一后缀从希腊语经拉丁语进入英语。该词二十世纪初已有记录，并随大众政治运动而流行。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the same driving root; the near-meaning group gathers people who press for change in different ways.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「驱动」词根的一族词；近义组收以不同方式推动改变的人。

entries.definition: The noun for the work of activists, formed with the suffix -ism.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动主义、社会运动」，由本词加后缀 -ism 构成。

entries.definition: The root verb and noun meaning to do something or a thing done.
entries.definitionCN: 动词兼名词，义为「行动、行为」，是这一词族的基础词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning taking action rather than waiting; it stands behind activist.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「积极的、活跃的」，是 activist 的直接来源之一。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to set something going, literally to make it act.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「启动、激活」，字面就是「使其行动」。

entries.definition: A person who makes art; it merely looks close and comes from Latin ars, not from agere.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「艺术家」；只是拼写相近，词源不同，出自拉丁语 ars。

entries.definition: A person who takes part in an organized campaign, often with a formal group behind them.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「运动参与者、竞选者」，往往背后有正式组织。

entries.definition: A person who shows public disagreement, especially at a demonstration.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「抗议者」，尤指在示威现场公开表达反对的人。

entries.definition: A person who publicly supports a cause, often by speaking and writing rather than acting.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「倡导者」，多靠言论与写作支持某项主张。

entries.definition: A person who joins a march or rally; the emphasis is on the event, not on a long campaign.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「示威者」，强调参加某场游行集会，而非长期运动。

entries.definition: A person paid to persuade politicians, working inside the system rather than in the street.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「说客」，受雇游说政客，走体制内渠道而非街头。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root, the person suffix and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子借助真实的拉丁词根、人物后缀，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Act is the root: an activist is someone who acts rather than watches.
normal.cn: act 是词根：activist 就是去做而不是旁观的人。

normal.en: The suffix -ist marks a person, as in artist or scientist; here the person drives a cause.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ist 标记人，如 artist、scientist；在这里，这个人推动的是一项事业。

normal.en: Activism is the activity, and activist is the person who carries it out.
normal.cn: activism 指这项活动，activist 指从事它的人。

normal.en: Environmental activist and human rights activist are the two commonest patterns.
normal.cn: environmental activist 与 human rights activist 是最常见的两种搭配。

normal.en: In finance an activist investor pushes a company; the same word, a different arena.
normal.cn: 在金融里，activist investor 推动一家公司；同一个词，换了个场域。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pushing a heavy door: the door is the old rule, the hand is the activist.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在推一扇沉重的门：门是旧规矩，手就是活动人士。

abstract.en: A sign held above a crowd works like a small sail catching a large wind.
abstract.cn: 人群中举起的标语，像一面小帆接住了一阵大风。

abstract.en: The pushing can be praised or blamed; what stays constant is that someone refuses to stand still.
abstract.cn: 这股推动力可能被赞许，也可能被指责；不变的是有人拒绝原地站着。

examples.en: Local activists have been pressing the council for cleaner air.
examples.cn: 当地的活动人士一直在要求市议会改善空气质量。

examples.en: She works as a climate activist while holding a full-time job.
examples.cn: 她一边做全职工作，一边从事气候运动。

examples.en: The board gave in after an activist investor bought a large stake.
examples.cn: 一名积极介入的投资人买下大量股份后，董事会作出了让步。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱克提维斯特」——爱把问题「提」到台面上的人：活动人士。

root: 由 act 加后缀 -ist 构成；act 出自拉丁语 agere「驱动、做」的过去分词 actus，-ist 源自希腊语 -istes，经拉丁语 -ista 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses name the same pushing force: a person who drives a cause, a party, a single issue, a protest, a network, a company, or a court.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项指的是同一股推动力：推动一项事业、一个政党、一个单一议题、一场抗议、一张网络、一家公司，或一座法院的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person holding a sign at a street corner, pushing an idea into public view.
core.cn: 核心意象：街角一个举着标语的人，把一个想法推到公众眼前。

branches.en: THE PERSON: the doer suffix turns the drive into a person who keeps a cause moving.
branches.cn: 人物线：表示做事者的后缀把「驱动」变成一个人，他让一项事业持续向前。

branches.en: THE GROUP: inside a party or an online network, the same doer does the everyday work of organizing.
branches.cn: 团体线：无论在政党里还是在网络里，同一个做事者承担着日常的组织工作。

branches.en: THE CAUSE: a single issue becomes the thing driven, and the driver takes its name.
branches.cn: 议题线：单一议题成为被推动之物，推动者便以它命名。

branches.en: THE STREET: the most physical driving is a body placed in the way.
branches.cn: 街头线：最物理的驱动，是把身体挡在路上。

branches.en: THE MARKET AND THE COURT: the same force is hired in an investor, described in a policy, and blamed in a judge.
branches.cn: 市场与法庭线：同一股力量，在投资人身上被雇用，在政策上被描述，在法官身上被指责。

intro.en: The word is a Latin root plus an English noun and adjective pattern; the suffixes below build the rest of the family.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁词根加上英语的名词与形容词构词方式；下面这些后缀撑起了整个词族。

latinIntro.en: Agere, actus and actio are recorded Latin forms; the Indo-European root above them is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere、actus、actio 都是有文献记录的拉丁语形式；更早的印欧词根属于重构形式。

items.example: The root lies behind Latin agere.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根藏在拉丁语 agere 之后。

items.example: Agere is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: agere 是这一整族的源头。

items.example: The participle actus gave English act.
items.exampleCN: 分词 actus 给出了英语的 act。

items.example: Act is the base that carries the family in English.
items.exampleCN: act 是这个词族在英语里的承载词。

items.meaning: a person who does or believes
items.exampleCN: 它构成 activist 与 artist。
它构成 activism。
它构成 active。
它构成 activate。
它构成 actor 与 activator。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「行动主义；社会运动」
由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「行动主义的」
由前缀加本词构成，义为「反对活动人士的」

definition_zh: 活动；活动性；活跃；经济活动；生理活性
definition_en: something that people do, or the state of being busy and full of movement
core_image: 手上正忙的那件事：脚在走、手在动、脑子在转
scene: 周末的社区中心里，孩子们在走廊上跑来跑去，老人围在桌边下棋。The center offers evening activities for teenagers.
sceneCN: 这里 activity 指「机构安排的具体活动项目」（第 6 个义项：学校或机构组织的活动）；句意为该中心为青少年安排了晚间活动。

pos.zh: 名词：活动；活动性；活跃；经济活动；活性

derivatives.zh: 由否定前缀 in- 加本词构成，义为「不活动；停滞」
由前缀 hyper- 加本词构成，义为「活动过度；多动」

senses.title: Something done for interest or purpose
senses.titleCN: 为兴趣或目的做的一件活动
senses.definition: a thing that a person does, especially for interest, pleasure or a practical purpose
senses.definitionCN: 一个人所做的事，尤指出于兴趣、娱乐或实际目的
senses.example: Reading is a quiet activity that she enjoys after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 读书是她晚饭后喜欢的一项安静活动。
senses.why: The root actus is a doing; adding -ity turns one instance of doing into a countable thing you can name and schedule.
senses.whyCN: 词根 actus 就是「做」；加上 -ity 之后，一次「做」变成了一件可以命名、可以安排的具体事情。

senses.title: The state of being busy and active
senses.definition: the state of being busy, energetic or full of movement, often used of a place or a period
senses.definitionCN: 忙碌、有活力或充满动静的状态，常用于描述场所或时段
senses.example: The station was a hive of activity at seven in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 早上七点时，车站里一片繁忙。
senses.why: The same noun can name not a thing but a condition: when many acts are happening at once, the place itself is said to be full of activity.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词也可以不指具体事物，而指一种状态：当许多「做」同时发生时，这个场所本身就被说成充满活动。

senses.title: Economic or business activity
senses.definition: the amount of buying, selling, producing and working that happens in an economy or a company
senses.definitionCN: 一个经济体或一家公司中发生的买卖、生产与工作的总量
senses.example: Building permits are a good sign of economic activity.
senses.exampleCN: 建筑许可数量是经济活动的一个良好指标。
senses.why: In economics the doing is counted rather than pictured: activity becomes a measurable volume of transactions.
senses.whyCN: 在经济学里，「做」被计数而不是被描绘：activity 成了可以衡量的交易总量。

senses.title: Electrical or physical action in the body
senses.definition: the working of a body part, especially electrical signals in the brain or muscles, or bodily movement
senses.definitionCN: 身体某部分的工作，尤指大脑或肌肉中的电信号，或身体的运动
senses.example: The scan showed unusual activity in the left hemisphere.
senses.exampleCN: 扫描显示左半球有异常活动。
senses.why: Life is constant doing at a scale we cannot see, so the same word is used for signals that a machine can record.
senses.whyCN: 生命在看不见的尺度上一直在「做」，于是同一个词也用来指仪器能记录下的信号。

senses.title: Movement in the earth
senses.definition: the movement of magma, heat or pressure inside the earth that shows on the surface
senses.definitionCN: 地球内部岩浆、热量或压力的运动，并在表面表现出来
senses.example: Scientists recorded increased volcanic activity last month.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家上个月记录到火山活动增强。
senses.why: The earth too is a body that does things; when it stirs, the noun that names doing is applied to it.
senses.whyCN: 地球也是一个会「做事」的躯体；当它躁动时，那个表示「做」的名词就用到了它身上。

senses.title: An organized programme of events
senses.titleCN: 学校或机构组织的活动
senses.definition: an event or programme arranged by a school, club or centre for its members
senses.definitionCN: 学校、社团或中心为其成员安排的活动或活动方案
senses.example: The center offers evening activities for teenagers.
senses.exampleCN: 该中心为青少年安排了晚间活动。
senses.why: When institutions plan the doing in advance, the countable plural becomes the normal form: activities on a timetable.
senses.whyCN: 当机构事先把「做」安排进日程，可数复数就成了常规形式：activities 排在一张时间表上。

senses.title: Chemical or enzyme activity
senses.definition: the strength with which a substance, enzyme or catalyst produces a chemical effect
senses.definitionCN: 某种物质、酶或催化剂产生化学效应的强度
senses.example: Heat quickly destroys the enzyme activity in fresh milk.
senses.exampleCN: 高温会迅速破坏鲜奶中的酶活性。
senses.why: In a laboratory the doing is a rate: how much reaction happens per unit of time is called activity.
senses.whyCN: 在实验室里，「做」体现为一个速率：单位时间内发生多少反应，就被称为活性。

senses.title: Suspicious or hostile movement
senses.definition: in police or military language, movement or behaviour that is watched because it may be hostile or illegal
senses.definitionCN: 警察或军方用语，指因可能敌对或违法而被监视的动向或行为
senses.example: The guard reported unusual activity along the fence.
senses.exampleCN: 守卫报告围栏一带出现了异常动向。
senses.why: Anything that moves where nothing should move draws the eye; activity becomes the neutral word for what is being watched.
senses.whyCN: 在本不该有动静的地方出现动静就会引人注意；activity 成了指代「被监视之物」的中性词。

intro.en: Activity is a Latin noun of action built on the same driving verb as act, with a suffix that turns doing into a state or a countable thing.
intro.cn: activity 是与 act 同出一个「驱动」动词的拉丁语动作名词，后缀把「做」变成一种状态或一件可数的事。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as 'to drive, set in motion'; the deeper origin of the root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 表示「驱动、使运动」；这个词根更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Agere meant 'to drive, do, act', and it supplied the whole family with its core sense of doing.
items.cn: agere 意为「驱动、做、行动」，为整个词族提供了「做」这一核心含义。

items.en: The noun and participle actus meant 'a doing, an act'; from it came the adjective activus, 'active, practical'.
items.cn: 名词兼分词 actus 意为「作为、行为」；由它生出形容词 activus，义为「活跃的、实际的」。

items.en: Medieval Latin activitas named the quality of being active; it was formed from activus plus the noun suffix -itas.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 activitas 指「活跃」这一性质，由 activus 加名词后缀 -itas 构成。

items.en: English took the word through Middle French activite in the sixteenth century; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪经中古法语 activite 借入这个词；确切首见年代不确定。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the act family and its suffixes; the near-meaning group gathers words for what people do and for how much is going on.
note.cn: 形近组收 act 词族及其后缀派生词；近义组收表示「人所做的事」与「事情多寡」的词。

entries.definition: The base verb and noun meaning to do something or a thing done.
entries.definitionCN: 动词兼名词，义为「行动、行为」，是本词的基础词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning busy, energetic or taking part; activity is its noun.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活跃的、积极参与的」，activity 正是它的名词形式。

entries.definition: A deed or the process of doing, often with the idea of effort or effect.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、动作」，常带有用力或产生效果的意味。

entries.definition: To set something going; literally to make it act.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「启动、激活」，字面就是「使其行动」。

entries.definition: Something done for enjoyment in free time; narrower and always leisure.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「消遣、娱乐」，范围更窄，只指闲暇时的活动。

entries.definition: An activity that a person gives time to, often over years; formal in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「爱好、事务」，指长期投入的活动，语气正式。

entries.definition: The working of a system, business or machine rather than of a person.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「运转、运营」，指系统、企业或机器的运行，而非人的活动。

entries.definition: The normal working of a body part or system; the biological match for the body sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「功能、机能」，正对应 activity 的身体与生理义。

entries.definition: Physical activity done to stay healthy; narrower and always bodily.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「锻炼」，范围更窄，只指为健康而做的身体活动。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the real suffixes, the countable plural and the common domain phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借助真实的后缀、可数复数，以及各领域里的常见搭配。

normal.en: Act is the root, -ive makes the adjective active, and -ity turns it into a noun.
normal.cn: act 是词根，-ive 构成形容词 active，-ity 再把它变成名词。

normal.en: The plural changes y to ies: activities, like cities and duties.
normal.cn: 复数把 y 变 ies：activities，和 cities、duties 一样变化。

normal.en: Physical activity is what a doctor prescribes; economic activity is what a government measures.
normal.cn: physical activity 是医生开出的处方；economic activity 是政府衡量的对象。

normal.en: In a laboratory, activity is a rate: how fast a reaction runs.
normal.cn: 在实验室里，activity 是一个速率：反应跑得多快。

normal.en: A school timetable lists activities; a police report notes suspicious activity.
normal.cn: 学校的时刻表上列着 activities；警方的报告里记着 suspicious activity。

abstract.en: Picture a room where many small lights switch on at once: that glow is activity.
abstract.cn: 想象一个房间里许多小灯同时亮起：那一片亮光就是 activity。

abstract.en: The same glow can be a busy market, a firing brain or a stirring volcano.
abstract.cn: 同一片亮光可以是热闹的市场、放电的大脑，也可以是躁动的火山。

abstract.en: Activity is never the thing itself; it is the fact that something is happening.
abstract.cn: activity 从来不是那个东西本身，而是「有事情正在发生」这一事实。

examples.en: Reading is a quiet activity that she enjoys after dinner.
examples.cn: 读书是她晚饭后喜欢的一项安静活动。

examples.en: The doctor said he needs more physical activity.
examples.cn: 医生说他需要更多的身体活动。

examples.en: Police are looking into suspicious activity near the warehouse.
examples.cn: 警方正在调查仓库附近的可疑活动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱克提维提」——爱「提」着事做，一天到晚忙不停：活动、活跃。

root: 由 act 加名词后缀 -ity 构成；act 出自拉丁语 agere「驱动、做」的过去分词 actus，-ity 源自拉丁语 -itas，经中古法语 -ite 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: One noun covers both the deed and the condition: a single thing done, a place full of doing, a volume of trade, a signal in a body or a rock, a scheduled programme, a reaction rate, a watched movement.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个名词既指「所做的事」，也指「正在发生的状态」：一件具体的事、一个忙碌的场所、一笔交易总量、身体或岩石中的信号、排进日程的项目、一个反应速率，或一段被监视的动向。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand already busy, a foot already moving, a mind already turning.
core.cn: 核心意象：手已经在忙，脚已经在走，脑子已经在转。

branches.en: THE THING DONE: one act becomes a named item, and institutions put such items on a timetable.
branches.cn: 所做之事线：一次「做」变成一件有名字的事，机构再把这样的事排进日程。

branches.en: THE STATE: when many acts happen together, the place itself is described as full of activity.
branches.cn: 状态线：当许多「做」同时发生，场所本身就被形容为充满活动。

branches.en: THE ECONOMY: doing is counted as a volume of trade and production.
branches.cn: 经济线：「做」被折算成交易与生产的可测总量。

branches.en: THE BODY AND THE EARTH: life and rock both keep doing things at a scale we cannot see.
branches.cn: 身体与大地线：生命与岩石都在看不见的尺度上持续活动。

branches.en: THE SIGNAL: in a lab or on a monitor, activity is something detected, whether a reaction rate or a hostile movement.
branches.cn: 信号线：在实验室或监视屏上，activity 是被探测到的东西，无论是反应速率还是敌对动向。

intro.en: Activity is built from the act root plus two Latin suffixes; the same pieces build active, action and activate.
intro.cn: activity 由 act 词根加两个拉丁后缀构成；同一批部件还构成 active、action 与 activate。

latinIntro.en: Agere, actus, activus and activitas are all recorded Latin forms; only the Indo-European root above them is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere、actus、activus 与 activitas 都是有文献记录的拉丁语形式；只有更早的印欧词根属于重构形式。

items.example: The root lies behind Latin agere.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根藏在拉丁语 agere 之后。

items.example: Agere supplies the core sense of doing.
items.exampleCN: agere 提供了「做」这一核心含义。

items.example: Actus is the noun of action in the family.
items.exampleCN: actus 是这个词族的动作名词。

items.example: Activus is the base of activitas.
items.exampleCN: activus 是 activitas 的基础。
它构成 active。
它把 active 变成 activity。
它构成 inactivity。
它构成 activate。

derivatives.zh: 由否定前缀加本词构成，义为「不活动；停滞」
由前缀加本词构成，义为「活动过度；多动」
由本词与 tracker 复合而成，指记录运动量的设备

definition_zh: 演员；行动者；参与者；行为体；原告
definition_en: a person who performs in plays or films, or a person or body that takes part in an action or process
core_image: 台口的那个人：灯一亮，他一张口就成了另一个人
scene: 排练厅的灯一盏一盏亮起来，导演让所有人安静。The young actor forgot his lines twice before the break.
sceneCN: 这里 actor 指「在舞台或银幕上表演的人」（第 1 个义项：演员）；句意为那名年轻演员在休息前两次忘了台词。

pos.zh: 名词：演员；行动者；参与者；行为体

collocations.zh: （计算机）角色模型、执行体模型

derivatives.zh: 由本词加阴性后缀 -ess 构成，义为「女演员」
由本词加形容词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「演员做派的」
由本词与 manager 复合而成，指自组剧团并兼任主演的经理

senses.title: A performer on stage or screen
senses.definition: a person who performs a role in a play, film or television programme
senses.definitionCN: 在戏剧、电影或电视节目中扮演角色的人
senses.example: The young actor forgot his lines twice before the break.
senses.exampleCN: 那名年轻演员在休息前两次忘了台词。
senses.why: Latin actor was simply 'a doer'; the stage keeps the doing but puts a script and an audience around it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actor 本义就是「做事的人」；舞台保留了这个「做」，只是在外面加了剧本和观众。

senses.title: A participant in an event
senses.definition: a person or group that takes part in an event or process and can influence it
senses.definitionCN: 参与某个事件或过程并能对其施加影响的人或团体
senses.example: Several outside actors helped push the talks forward.
senses.exampleCN: 几个外部参与者推动了会谈的进展。
senses.why: Strip away the stage and only the doing remains: whoever acts in a situation is an actor in it.
senses.whyCN: 去掉舞台，只剩下「做」：在任何局面里有所行动的人，就是这个局面中的 actor。

senses.title: A unit of action in social theory
senses.definition: in sociology and economics, an individual or group treated as a unit that chooses and acts
senses.definitionCN: 在社会学与经济学中，被当作一个会选择、会行动的单位的个人或群体
senses.example: The model assumes a rational actor with full information.
senses.exampleCN: 该模型假定存在一个掌握完全信息的理性行动者。
senses.why: Theory needs a smallest doer to build on, so the old word is reused as a technical term for that unit.
senses.whyCN: 理论需要一个最小的「做事单位」作为基础，于是这个旧词被重新用作该单位的技术术语。

senses.title: A state or non-state body in world politics
senses.definition: in international relations, a state, organization or group that acts on the world stage
senses.definitionCN: 在国际关系中，在世界舞台上采取行动的国家、组织或团体
senses.example: No single state actor could settle the dispute alone.
senses.exampleCN: 没有任何单一国家行为体能独自解决这场争端。
senses.why: When the doer is a country rather than a person, the same noun still fits, because acting is what is being named.
senses.whyCN: 当做事者是一个国家而不是一个人时，同一个名词仍然适用，因为被命名的是「行动」本身。

senses.title: The plaintiff in civil law
senses.definition: in Scots law and some civil-law systems, the person who brings a case against another
senses.definitionCN: 在苏格兰法及部分大陆法系中，对他人提起诉讼的一方
senses.example: In Scots law the pursuer, not the plaintiff, is called the actor.
senses.exampleCN: 在苏格兰法里，提起诉讼的一方被称为 actor，而不是 plaintiff。
senses.why: A lawsuit is also a doing, and the one who starts it is the doer, so the courtroom kept the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 诉讼同样是一种「做」，发起它的人就是做事者，于是法庭保留了这个最古老的含义。

senses.title: Someone good at hiding feelings
senses.definition: a person who is good at pretending or at keeping true feelings hidden
senses.definitionCN: 擅长假装或把真实情绪藏起来的人
senses.example: He is a good actor, so nobody noticed he was angry.
senses.exampleCN: 他很会掩饰，谁都没注意到他生气了。
senses.why: If acting is putting on another self, then everyday acting is doing the same thing without a stage.
senses.whyCN: 如果表演是换上另一个自我，那么日常里的「演」就是在没有舞台的地方做同一件事。

senses.title: A unit of execution in software
senses.titleCN: 计算机模型中的执行体
senses.definition: in the actor model of computing, an independent unit that receives messages and acts on them
senses.definitionCN: 在计算机的角色模型中，接收消息并据此行动的独立单元
senses.example: Each actor keeps its own state and answers only through messages.
senses.exampleCN: 每个执行体维护自己的状态，只通过消息作出回应。
senses.why: A program is full of small doers that wait, receive and act, so engineering borrowed the plain word for a doer.
senses.whyCN: 程序里全是等待、接收并行动的小小「做事者」，于是工程领域借用了这个朴素的说法。

senses.title: A malicious party: bad actor
senses.definition: in the phrase bad actor, a person or organization that behaves dishonestly or harmfully
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 bad actor，指行为不诚实或造成伤害的个人或组织
senses.example: The platform promised to block bad actors within hours.
senses.exampleCN: 该平台承诺在数小时内封禁恶意行为者。
senses.why: The neutral word for a doer becomes a label for the wrong kind of doing once an adjective judges it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦形容词作出评判，这个中性的「做事者」就变成了对错误行为的标签。

intro.en: Actor is a Latin agent noun built on agere; English took it first as a word for a doer and only later for a performer.
intro.cn: actor 是建立在 agere 之上的拉丁语施事名词；英语先把它当作「做事的人」，后来才专指表演者。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as 'to drive, set in motion'; the deeper origin of this root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 表示「驱动、使运动」；这个词根更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Agere meant 'to drive, do, act', and it supplied the family with its sense of doing.
items.cn: agere 意为「驱动、做、行动」，为这一词族提供了「做」的含义。

items.en: Actor was the agent noun in -or, meaning 'a doer, a driver, a manager, a plaintiff'; the stage sense is not the oldest one.
items.cn: actor 是带 -or 的施事名词，义为「做事者、驱动者、管事者、原告」；表演义并不是最古老的含义。

items.en: English borrowed the word from Latin and Anglo-French, using it first for a doer, a steward or a party in a lawsuit.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语与盎格鲁法语借入这个词，最初指做事者、管事者或诉讼当事人。

items.en: The performer sense became dominant in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries; the computing sense is a twentieth-century extension.
items.cn: 表演义在十六、十七世纪成为主导；计算机义则是二十世纪的延伸。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the act family; the near-meaning group gathers performers and participants, which differ in whether there is a role to play.
note.cn: 形近组收 act 词族；近义组收表演者与参与者，区别在于是否需要扮演一个角色。

entries.definition: The base verb and noun meaning to do something or a thing done.
entries.definitionCN: 动词兼名词，义为「行动、行为」，是本词的基础词。

entries.definition: A deed or the process of doing, without the person who does it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、动作」，只指行为或过程，不含做事的人。

entries.definition: A female performer; the older feminine form of actor, now often avoided.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「女演员」，是 actor 较早的阴性形式，如今常被避免使用。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning busy or taking part; it shares the same Latin root.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活跃的、积极参与的」，与 actor 同出拉丁词根。

entries.definition: A person who entertains an audience; broader than actor and includes singers and dancers.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「表演者」，范围比 actor 宽，也包括歌手与舞者。

entries.definition: An old word for an actor, now mostly used of musicians or sportspeople.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，旧指「演员」，如今多用于乐手或运动员。

entries.definition: A person who takes part in something; it names membership, not influence.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「参与者」，只表明在场参与，不强调影响力。

entries.definition: A person or thing that produces an effect; the philosophical match for the acting sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「施动者、作用者」，是 actor 行动义在哲学语境中的对应词。

entries.definition: A person or group with an interest in a decision, whether or not they act in it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「利益相关方」，只强调有利益牵涉，未必实际采取行动。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the -or suffix, the two histories of the word and its modern technical uses.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借助 -or 后缀、这个词的两段历史，以及它在现代的专业用法。

normal.en: The suffix -or marks the doer, as in doctor or inspector; actor is simply one who acts.
normal.cn: 后缀 -or 标记做事者，如 doctor、inspector；actor 就是「行动的那个人」。

normal.en: Latin actor meant a doer long before it meant a performer.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 actor 在表示「演员」之前很久就表示「做事者」。

normal.en: Actress is the older feminine form, built with -ess.
normal.cn: actress 是较早的阴性形式，由 -ess 构成。

normal.en: State actor and non-state actor are standard terms in world politics.
normal.cn: state actor 与 non-state actor 是国际政治里的标准术语。

normal.en: Bad actor is the phrase for a malicious person or company.
normal.cn: bad actor 是表示恶意个人或公司的固定说法。

abstract.en: Picture a spotlight: whoever stands inside it is doing something for others to watch.
abstract.cn: 想象一束追光：站在光里的人，正在做一件给别人看的事。

abstract.en: Take the spotlight away and the same person is still doing something in a room, a market or a country.
abstract.cn: 把追光拿掉，同一个人仍然在房间、市场或国家里做着什么。

abstract.en: An actor can be a player, a process or a criminal; what they share is that they act.
abstract.cn: actor 可以是演员、一个进程或一名作恶者；共同点在于他们都在行动。

examples.en: The young actor forgot his lines twice before the break.
examples.cn: 那名年轻演员在休息前两次忘了台词。

examples.en: Several outside actors helped push the talks forward.
examples.cn: 几个外部参与者推动了会谈的进展。

examples.en: The platform promised to block bad actors within hours.
examples.cn: 该平台承诺在数小时内封禁恶意行为者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱克特」——爱「演」的那位特型人物：演员，也指行动者。

root: 拉丁语 actor「做事者、管事者、原告」由 agere「驱动、做」加施事后缀 -or 构成；agere 的过去分词是 actus。表演义到近代才成为主导。

sensesIntro.en: Every sense names one who acts: on a stage, in an event, in a theory, on the world stage, in a court, behind a mask, inside a program, or on the wrong side.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都指「行动的那个人」：在舞台上、在事件里、在理论中、在世界舞台上、在法庭里、在面具后、在程序中，或在错误的一边。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure at the front of the stage, lit from above, about to speak.
core.cn: 核心意象：舞台前方被顶光照住的一个身影，正要开口。

branches.en: THE STAGE: the doer is given a script and an audience.
branches.cn: 舞台线：做事者被配上剧本和观众。

branches.en: THE PARTICIPANT: remove the stage and the doer is simply whoever acts in a situation or a model.
branches.cn: 参与者线：去掉舞台，做事者就是在局面或模型中有所行动的那一方。

branches.en: THE WORLD STAGE: whole states can be the ones that act.
branches.cn: 世界舞台线：行动的单位可以整个国家。

branches.en: THE COURT: the one who starts a case is still the doer.
branches.cn: 法庭线：发起诉讼的人依旧是那个做事者。

branches.en: OTHER DRESSES: the doer may be a pretender, a software process, or a malicious party.
branches.cn: 其他装束线：这个做事者可能是装样子的人、一个软件进程，或一个作恶的组织。

intro.cn: actor 是一个纯粹的拉丁语施事名词；英语只在它周围加了阴性后缀与形容词后缀。

items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词已经同时含有「做事者」与「表演者」的萌芽。

items.exampleCN: act 在日常英语里承载着这个词族。

definition_zh: 实际的；真实的；现实的；现有的；事实上的
definition_en: real and existing in fact, rather than imagined, claimed or expected
core_image: 手按在实物上：不是图样，不是说法，就是眼前这一件
scene: 图纸上的数字很好看，可工人到现场一量，尺寸差了两指。The actual cost was almost twice the estimate.
sceneCN: 这里 actual 指「真实发生的数额」（第 2 个义项：与声称或估算相对的实际数额）；句意为实际成本几乎是估算的两倍。

由本词加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「现实；实际情况」
由本词加动词后缀 -ize 构成，义为「实现；使成为现实」
由动词 actualize 加名词后缀构成，义为「实现；现实化」

senses.title: Real, not imagined or invented
senses.definition: existing in fact and not produced by imagination, rumour or invention
senses.definitionCN: 真实存在的，而非想象、传言或编造出来的
senses.example: The film is based on the actual events of that winter.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片依据那个冬天的真实事件改编。
senses.why: Latin actualis meant 'active, practical'; from 'what is done' the sense slid to 'what really is', because a deed leaves something behind that others can check.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actualis 本义是「行动的、实际的」；从「被做出来的事」滑向「真实存在的东西」，因为行为会留下别人能核对的痕迹。

senses.title: The real amount behind a claim
senses.titleCN: 与声称或估算相对的实际数额
senses.definition: used of a sum, cost or figure to mean the one that truly applies, as opposed to an estimate or a claim
senses.definitionCN: 用于金额、成本或数字，指真正适用的那一个，与估算或声称相对
senses.example: The actual cost was almost twice the estimate.
senses.exampleCN: 实际成本几乎是估算的两倍。
senses.why: When a number is announced, people ask what was really done; the adjective marks the measured figure against the spoken one.
senses.whyCN: 数字被报出来时，人们会问真正做了多少；这个形容词就把量出来的数与被说出来的数区分开。

senses.title: Exact and precise
senses.definition: used to stress that a figure or word is the exact one, not an approximate one
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调某个数字或词语是确切的那一个，而非约略的说法
senses.example: Do you know the actual number of people who came?
senses.exampleCN: 你知道来的人的确切数目吗？
senses.why: If actual picks out what truly is, then in talk about numbers it picks out the precise value rather than a round one.
senses.whyCN: 如果 actual 挑出的是「真正存在的」，那么在谈数字时，它挑出的就是精确值而不是约数。

senses.title: Existing at the present time
senses.definition: used of a situation or state to mean the one that exists now, as opposed to a past or future one
senses.definitionCN: 用于情况或状态，指当下存在的那个，与过去或未来相对
senses.example: We need to describe the actual situation, not the one we hope for.
senses.exampleCN: 我们要描述的是现有情况，而不是我们希望出现的情况。
senses.why: What is real is real now; the adjective therefore slides from 'real' to 'current' whenever a situation is being compared across time.
senses.whyCN: 真实的东西是在此刻真实的；所以只要把情况放在时间上比较，这个词就从「真实」滑向「当前」。

senses.title: Practical rather than theoretical
senses.titleCN: 实际操作中的（与理论相对）
senses.definition: used of results or conditions in real use, as opposed to what theory or a design predicts
senses.definitionCN: 指真实使用中的结果或条件，与理论或设计的预测相对
senses.example: The actual performance of the engine was far below the brochure.
senses.exampleCN: 这台发动机的实际表现远低于宣传册上的数字。
senses.why: This is the oldest layer of the word: actualis named what is done in practice, and theory is what has not yet been done.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最古老的一层：actualis 指在实践中做出来的东西，而理论是尚未做出来的东西。

senses.title: In effect, whether lawful or not
senses.definition: used of power or control that is really exercised, whether or not it is officially recognised
senses.definitionCN: 指真正被行使的权力或控制，无论是否得到正式承认
senses.example: The general held actual control of the region for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这位将军多年来掌握着该地区的实际控制权。
senses.why: Law distinguishes the paper title from the hand that holds the key, and actual marks the hand.
senses.whyCN: 法律要把纸面上的名分和真正拿着钥匙的那只手分开，actual 标的就是那只手。

senses.title: Legal: actual rather than presumed
senses.titleCN: 法律上的「实际的」（与推定相对）
senses.definition: in law, describing knowledge, notice or authority that is proved to exist, as opposed to one the law presumes
senses.definitionCN: 在法律中形容经证明存在的知情、通知或授权，与法律推定相对
senses.example: The court found actual notice, not merely constructive notice.
senses.exampleCN: 法院认定存在实际知悉，而不仅仅是推定知悉。
senses.why: Legal systems already have a word for what is presumed; they need the opposite term for what can be shown, and actual fills that slot.
senses.whyCN: 法律体系本来就有词表示「推定」，还需要一个相反的词表示「能举证证实的」，actual 正好补上这个位置。

senses.title: Actuals: recorded figures in finance
senses.definition: as a plural noun in accounting, the figures that have really been earned or spent, compared with a budget or forecast
senses.definitionCN: 会计中作复数名词，指真实发生收入或支出的数字，用以与预算或预测比较
senses.example: The report compares this year's actuals with the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告把今年的实际数据与预算作了比较。
senses.why: Once 'actual' is fixed as the opposite of forecast, it can stand alone as a noun: the actuals are the numbers that really happened.
senses.whyCN: 一旦 actual 被固定为 forecast 的对立面，它就能单独作名词：actuals 就是真正发生了的那些数字。

intro.en: Actual comes from the same Latin root as act, but it entered English meaning 'active' and only later shifted to 'real'.
intro.cn: actual 与 act 同出拉丁词根，但它进入英语时意思是「活跃的」，后来才转为「真实的」。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as 'to drive, set in motion'; the deeper origin of this root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 表示「驱动、使运动」；这个词根更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Agere meant 'to drive, do, act', and its past participle actus gave the noun for a deed.
items.cn: agere 意为「驱动、做、行动」，其过去分词 actus 给出了表示「行为」的名词。

items.en: Late Latin actualis meant 'active, practical, of a deed', formed from actus plus the adjective suffix -alis.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 actualis 意为「活跃的、实际的、与行为有关的」，由 actus 加形容词后缀 -alis 构成。

items.en: English borrowed the word through Old French actuel, where it still meant 'active, practical' rather than 'real'.
items.cn: 英语经古法语 actuel 借入这个词，当时它仍表示「活跃的、实际的」，而非「真实的」。

items.en: The modern sense 'existing in fact' established itself in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, and the old sense 'active' survives mainly in actuality and in the adverb.
items.cn: 「真实存在的」这一现代义在十六、十七世纪确立；旧的「活跃」义主要残留在 actuality 与副词形式里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the act family; the near-meaning group gathers words for what is real, each with a different test of reality.
note.cn: 形近组收 act 词族；近义组收表示「真实」的词，各自检验真实的标准不同。

entries.definition: The noun for reality or for real circumstances, formed with -ity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「现实、实际情况」，由本词加 -ity 构成。

entries.definition: To make something real, formed with the verb suffix -ize.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「实现、使成为现实」，由本词加动词后缀构成。

entries.definition: The base verb and noun meaning to do something or a thing done.
entries.definitionCN: 动词兼名词，义为「行动、行为」，是本词的基础词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning busy or taking part; it keeps the older sense of actual.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活跃的、积极参与的」，保留了 actual 较早的那层含义。

entries.definition: Existing as a thing rather than as an idea; the broadest and plainest of these words.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「真实的、实在的」，是这组词里范围最宽也最朴素的一个。

entries.definition: Real and not faked; the test is authenticity rather than existence.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「真正的、非伪造的」，检验的是真伪而非是否存在。

entries.definition: Based on facts and able to be checked; it describes accounts rather than things.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「基于事实的」，描述的是叙述而非事物本身。

entries.definition: Specific and definite, the opposite of vague; it tests precision of detail.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「具体的、明确的」，与含糊相对，检验的是细节是否确定。

entries.definition: In accordance with the facts; used of statements, not of costs or objects.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「正确的、符合事实的」，多用于陈述，而非成本或物件。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the Latin suffix, the shift from 'active' to 'real', and the phrases that keep the word alive.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借助拉丁后缀、从「活跃」到「真实」的语义转变，以及让这个词活着的常见搭配。

normal.en: Actus is a deed, and -alis means 'of'; actual at first meant 'of a deed', that is, practical.
normal.cn: actus 是「行为」，-alis 表示「与……有关」；actual 最初就是「与行为有关的」，也就是实际的。

normal.en: In actual fact keeps the old and the new sense side by side.
normal.cn: in actual fact 这个搭配把新旧两层意思并排放着。

normal.en: The actual cost is what the bill says, not what the estimate said.
normal.cn: the actual cost 是账单上写的数，不是估算时说的数。

normal.en: Add -ly and you get the adverb actually, which lives a very different life.
normal.cn: 加上 -ly 就得到副词 actually，它的用法完全是另一套。

normal.en: In law, actual notice is proved, while constructive notice is presumed.
normal.cn: 在法律里，actual notice 是被证明的，constructive notice 是被推定的。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pressed flat on a table: the table is there whether or not anyone describes it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手平按在桌面上：无论有没有人描述，桌子都在那里。

abstract.en: A drawing of the table can be wrong; the table that the hand touches cannot.
abstract.cn: 桌子的图可能画错；手摸到的那张桌子不会错。

abstract.en: Every sense of actual is a test of that touch: does it exist, is it exact, is it now, does it hold power.
abstract.cn: actual 的每个义项都是对这一次触摸的检验：它存在吗、精确吗、是现在吗、握着权力吗。

examples.en: The actual cost was almost twice the estimate.
examples.cn: 实际成本几乎是估算的两倍。

examples.en: Do you know the actual number of people who came?
examples.cn: 你知道来的人的确切数目吗？

examples.en: The report compares this year's actuals with the budget.
examples.cn: 这份报告把今年的实际数据与预算作了比较。

sensesIntro.en: One adjective keeps asking what is really there: a real event, a measured sum, an exact figure, the present state, practical results, power in hand, proved knowledge, or the numbers in a ledger.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个形容词一直在追问「真正在那里的是什么」：真实的事件、量出来的金额、确切的数字、当下的状态、实践中的结果、手中的权力、被证明的知情，或账本上的数字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat hand on a solid object, checking that it is really there.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手掌按在实物上，确认它真的在那里。

branches.en: THE THING ITSELF: what happened is not what was imagined or invented.
branches.cn: 事物本身线：发生过的事，不是想象或编造出来的。

branches.en: THE NUMBER: the measured figure beats the spoken or estimated one, and the exact value beats the round one.
branches.cn: 数字线：量出来的数胜过说出来的数和估算，精确值胜过约数。

branches.en: THE PRESENT AND THE PRACTICE: what is real is real now, and real results are the ones seen in use.
branches.cn: 当下与实践线：真实的东西在此刻真实，真实的结果是在使用中看到的结果。

branches.en: THE LAW: actual marks the power that is truly held and the knowledge that can be proved.
branches.cn: 法律线：actual 标出真正握有的权力和能够被证明的知情。

branches.en: THE LEDGER: once set against forecast, the word can stand alone as a plural noun.
branches.cn: 账本线：一旦与预测相对，这个词就能单独作复数名词使用。

intro.en: Actual is the Latin adjective of the act root; English then adds -ly, -ity and -ize to build the rest of the family.
intro.cn: actual 是 act 词根的拉丁形容词形式；英语再通过 -ly、-ity 与 -ize 长出其余词族。

latinIntro.en: Agere, actus and actualis are recorded Latin forms; the Indo-European root above them is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere、actus 与 actualis 都是有文献记录的拉丁语形式；更早的印欧词根属于重构形式。

definition_zh: 实际上；事实上；其实；竟然；的确
definition_en: used to say what is really true, often in contrast with what seems, is said or is expected
core_image: 把一句话翻个面：说得出的是一层，翻过来还有一层
scene: 他说自己不怕冷水，可刚把脚伸进去就缩了回来。He says the water is warm, but it is actually freezing.
sceneCN: 这里 actually 表示「实际上、其实」（第 1 个义项：与表象相反的真实情况）；句意为他说水是温的，可实际上冰凉刺骨。

pos.zh: 副词：实际上；事实上；其实；竟然；的确

derivatives.zh: 本词的形容词原形，义为「实际的；真实的」

senses.title: In reality, against appearances
senses.definition: used to state what is really the case when it differs from how something looks or seems
senses.definitionCN: 用于说明真实情况与表象不同时，真实的情况是什么
senses.example: He says the water is warm, but it is actually freezing.
senses.exampleCN: 他说水是温的，可实际上冰凉刺骨。
senses.why: The adjective actual marks what is really there; the adverb points at that reality and sets it against the look of things.
senses.whyCN: 形容词 actual 标出真正存在的东西；副词则指向这个真实，并把它与表象对立起来。

senses.title: In fact, stating the true state of things
senses.definition: used to give a fact that is true, often one that adds to or corrects what has just been said
senses.definitionCN: 用于给出一个真实的事实，常用来补充或修正刚说过的话
senses.example: The film is actually based on a true story.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影其实是根据真实故事改编的。
senses.why: Here the word does not fight an appearance; it simply puts the fact on the table, which is the plainest use of actual in adverb form.
senses.whyCN: 这里它并不与表象对抗，只是把事实摆到桌面上，这是 actual 副词形式最朴素的用法。

senses.title: Contrary to expectation
senses.definition: used to express surprise that something happened or was true, when it was not expected
senses.definitionCN: 用于表达意外：某事竟然发生或竟然是真的，而此前并未预料到
senses.example: He actually apologized, which nobody expected.
senses.exampleCN: 他竟然道歉了，谁都没料到。
senses.why: If actual means what really is, then saying it can carry a lift of surprise: reality has turned out unlike the expectation.
senses.whyCN: 如果 actual 指「真正存在的」，那么把它说出来就带上一层惊讶：现实与预期不一样。

senses.title: Really and truly, for emphasis
senses.definition: used to stress that a statement is true, especially when the listener may doubt it
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调某句话是真的，尤其在听者可能怀疑时
senses.example: I actually did call you three times yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 我昨天真的给你打了三次电话。
senses.why: The same emphasis on fact becomes emphasis on the speaker's sincerity when the doubt is about the person, not the world.
senses.whyCN: 当被怀疑的是说话人而不是世界时，同一个「强调事实」就变成了「强调诚意」。

senses.title: A soft correction at the start of a reply
senses.definition: used at the beginning of a reply to disagree or correct politely, softening the contradiction
senses.definitionCN: 用于回答开头，礼貌地表示不同意见或纠正，使反驳显得缓和
senses.example: Actually, I think the meeting starts at nine, not eight.
senses.exampleCN: 其实我觉得会议是九点开始，不是八点。
senses.why: The word offers the true version before the objection, so the correction arrives as a fact rather than a quarrel.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先把真实的版本递出去，再提出异议，于是纠错像在陈述事实，而不像在争吵。

senses.title: Introducing a new point or a change of subject
senses.definition: used in conversation to bring in a new thought or to move to a different topic
senses.definitionCN: 在对话中用于引入新的想法，或把话题转到别处
senses.example: Actually, before we order, I should mention the change of plan.
senses.exampleCN: 对了，点菜之前我得提一下计划有变。
senses.why: A word that marks reality is useful for marking a shift to something more real than the talk so far.
senses.whyCN: 一个标记「真实」的词，很适合用来标记话题转向比先前闲谈更真实的事情。

senses.title: In questions: asking whether it is really so
senses.titleCN: 用于疑问句：表示难以置信或确认
senses.definition: used in a question to show surprise or doubt and to ask whether something is really true
senses.definitionCN: 用于疑问句，表示惊讶或怀疑，并追问某事是否真的如此
senses.example: Do you actually believe that story?
senses.exampleCN: 你真的相信那个说法吗？
senses.why: Turn the statement into a question and the emphasis becomes a challenge: is this fact or only a claim.
senses.whyCN: 把陈述变成疑问，强调就变成了质问：这是事实，还是只是一个说法。

senses.title: Old use: at the present moment
senses.definition: in older texts, used to mean at the present time, a sense now largely replaced by currently
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的文本中表示「目前、此刻」，这一义项如今基本被 currently 取代
senses.example: The house is actually occupied by the family, as the letter says.
senses.exampleCN: 如信中所说，这所房子目前由这家人居住。
senses.why: Because actualis once meant 'active, in action', the adverb first meant 'in action now' before it came to mean 'in fact'.
senses.whyCN: 因为 actualis 曾经表示「活跃的、在行动中的」，副词最初就是「此刻正在发生」，后来才转为「事实上」。

intro.en: Actually is the adverb of actual; its oldest English sense was 'in action, actively', and 'in fact' came later.
intro.cn: actually 是 actual 的副词形式；它在英语里最早的意思是「在行动中、积极地」，「事实上」是后来才有的。

items.en: Agere meant 'to drive, do, act'; its past participle actus named a deed.
items.cn: agere 意为「驱动、做、行动」；其过去分词 actus 指一件行为。

items.en: Late Latin actualis meant 'active, practical, of a deed', built from actus with the suffix -alis.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 actualis 意为「活跃的、实际的、与行为有关的」，由 actus 加后缀 -alis 构成。

items.en: Actual entered English through Old French actuel and still carried the sense 'active, practical'.
items.cn: actual 经古法语 actuel 进入英语，当时仍带着「活跃的、实际的」这层意思。

items.en: The adverb actually is recorded from the fifteenth century with the sense 'actively, in action'; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 副词 actually 自十五世纪有记录，当时意为「积极地、在行动中」；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: By the seventeenth century actually was generally used for 'in reality'; the conversational uses, as a soft correction or to mark surprise, developed later still.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，actually 一般已用于表示「实际上」；作为委婉纠正或表示惊讶的口语用法出现得更晚。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the actual family; the near-meaning group gathers adverbs that also claim to give the truth, each with a different strength.
note.cn: 形近组收 actual 词族；近义组收同样声称给出真相的副词，但力度各不相同。
